data.desc: World-class portfolio, in stable and mining friendly U.S. jurisdictions, offering investors both near-term gold-copper production potential and blue-sky exploration upside. - CK Gold Project in Wyoming offers compelling value with approved development and operating permits advancing towards construction in an advantageous location. Keystone Gold Project in Nevada offers significant exploration opportunities, situated 11 miles on-trend south of Nevada Gold Mines' Cortez Complex, the second largest gold producer in NV. - Challis Gold Project in Idaho offers gold exploration potential in Idaho's historic mining district and ~12 miles SW of Revival Gold's 'brownfield' Beartrack-Arnett Project. Team of proven mine financiers, builders and explorers who have discovered and developed numerous world-class gold mines. Minimal share count (~16.5M shares outstanding), listed on NASDAQ including large insider holdings.
